guia.what: Represents a key or a keyboard combination. It renders as a `<kbd>` with the system’s styling.
whenUse: You’re documenting a shortcut, like `⌘K`, `Esc`, or `Ctrl + B`.
You’re telling the user which key to press, in the interface or in the docs.
dos: One key per `<kbd>`, and build combinations from several.
Use each key’s real name on each platform.
donts: Don’t use it as a decorative badge. It means “press this.”
